verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a consumer chat and community platform like Discord, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Bots, application commands and the Embedded App SDK are developer building blocks for third-party apps, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
